definitions.selected_generation: Latest status-bearing saved generation by maximum direct-file mtime_ns, then relative path; reviewer subdirectories excluded. This filesystem heuristic is not an owner delivery or scientific approval.
definitions.dossier: All eight core files plus nonempty actual query field and saved source URL, summary/extract, metadata; summary is not necessarily a verbatim extract. Not structural/scientific validation.
definitions.current_review: All declared evidence_hash_manifest/delivery_core_hashes/reviewed_evidence_hashes match selected root exactly; unrecognized schemas not accepted.
definitions.sets: Notes, dossiers and reviews overlap; versions are not duplicate units.

limitations: Only current partition inspected; excluded original-owner evidence not imported or counted as absent globally.
Metadata deficit does not imply unfinished research: zero-candidate units can have no source cards.
Current-hash accept count is conservative for recognized schemas and selected filesystem generation; not a replacement for all historical review metrics.
No new scientific review, validation approval or official completion.
